verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms Fly.io serves an llms.txt at https://fly.io/llms.txt (HTTP 200) with an agent-oriented product summary, so a user can point an agent at it directly. A machine-readable OpenAPI spec is also served, though that is adjacent rather than core to this story. Missing for 10: evidence of the llms.txt's depth and coverage beyond its opening lines, markdown versions of docs pages (docs.md returns 404), first-party documentation describing the agent-oriented docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration of agents using it.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://fly.io/llms.txt # Fly.io
Fly.io is a global public cloud for running full-stack and AI applications.
